ruleDefinitions.name: Potentially Suspicious Regsvr32 HTTP/FTP Pattern
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects regsvr32 execution to download/install/register new DLLs that are hosted on Web or FTP servers.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "REGSVR32\.EXE") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/i.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-i.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*ftp.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*http.*")))
